steps.expr: (() => { const svg=document.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) return JSON.stringify({ok:false,why:'no svg',title:document.title}); const rg=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g')].filter(x=>{const t=x.getAttribute('transform')||''; return t.includes('rotate') && t.includes('translate(0 -9)') && x.querySelector('path');}); if(!rg.length) return JSON.stringify({ok:false,why:'no rank g', title:document.title}); const m=rg[0].getAttribute('transform').match(/translate\(([\d.]+) ([\d.]+)\) rotate\(([\d.-]+)\)/); const rp={x:+m[1],y:+m[2]}; const C={x:320,y:330},R=185; const nx=(rp.x-C.x)/R, ny=(rp.y-C.y)/R; const expected={x:+(rp.x+nx*9).toFixed(1), y:+(rp.y+ny*9).toFixed(1)}; const ctm=rg[0].getCTM(); const actual={x:+ctm.e.toFixed(1), y:+ctm.f.toFixed(1)}; const tn=[...svg.querySelectorAll('text')].find(t=>t.textContent.includes('THUNDER')); const bn=tn?tn.getBBox():null; return JSON.stringify({ok:true, tang:+m[3].toFixed(1), expectedGlyphCenter:expected, actualOrigin:actual, residual:{x:+(actual.x-expected.x).toFixed(1), y:+(actual.y-expected.y).toFixed(1)}, nameBbox: bn?{x:+bn.x.toFixed(1),y:+bn.y.toFixed(1),w:+bn.width.toFixed(1)}:null}); })()
